title: Finite-k Professional output pilot
question: Can nextnano++ Professional export usable finite-k state, spinor and matrix data at k != 0?
pass_condition: Demo 25's PILOT_GATE.json records status PASS: more than one k point carries both energies and envelopes, and an identifiable k-vector file exists so each state can be tied to a k value. That is exactly enough to construct O_nm(k), z_e,nl(k) and z_hh,ml(k). Anything less is a FAIL and 27B stays blocked.

delegate.reason: Demo 25 was built for this exact question and has never been run. Its six variants isolate one candidate explanation each (k_integration, no_density, k_point_subdirectories, symmetry, dispersion coexistence, plus the Demo 23 control), so one work-laptop trip settles the syntax.

controlled_change.summary: Which per-k outputs nextnano++ is asked for, and whether the k-integration grid is enabled. Geometry, materials, mesh and temperature are Demo 23's, unchanged; Demo 25 enforces that with a structural diff against the Demo 23 deck.
